title: Linux Foundation networking: net-tools

date.notes: Page last-modified date shown by the wiki.

claims_extracted.claim: The Linux Foundation page describes net-tools as the base set of the Linux NET-3 networking distribution and lists included utilities.
The page states most net-tools programs are obsolete and maps route→ip route, ifconfig→ip addr, arp→ip neigh and related replacements.

notes: Institutional operational-migration anchor; exact first replacement dates require release/source archaeology.
